type Labels = Readonly<[string, ...number[]]>;
const labels: Labels = ["total", 1, 2];
const badLabels: Labels = ["total", "two"];

type Draft = Partial<[number, ...string[]]>;
const draft: Draft = [1, "a", undefined];
const badDraft: Draft = [1, false];

type Filled = Required<[number?, ...string[]]>;
const filled: Filled = [1, "a"];
const emptyFilled: Filled = [];

type Boxed<T> = { [K in keyof T]: { value: T[K] } };
type Row = Boxed<[string, ...number[], boolean]>;
const row: Row = [{ value: "id" }, { value: 1 }, { value: true }];
const badRow: Row = [{ value: "id" }, { value: "x" }, { value: true }];

console.log(labels, draft, filled, row);
